subject: [hw] DEC04 -> DEC07/T02: integration check of the VDEC_ALL model patch with a 0x30000 fake window (mmio_bad 0)
body:
I staged exactly the shape DEC07 proposed for tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c in a throwaway /tmp copy and ran the DEC04-patched vcu/n2vcu.c through n2vcu guest MMIO into it:

- tests/hw/n2vc_hw_fake.c: N2VC_FAKE_WIN_WORDS (0x4000/4) -> (0x30000/4); WINS[] gains { "VDEC_ALL", 0x30000, RWVC_BLK_VDEC_CORE } (13 entries with the staged rev-3 header).
- patched n2vcu.c (dec04.patch), guest mmap 0x40000 at 0x16000000, VDEC_CORE powered through the fake, store+load at 16 gap offsets: 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x3800, 0xd00c (larb5 sleep-protect), 0xe000, 0x11400, 0x11800, 0x12000, 0x13000, 0x14800, 0x16000, 0x18800, 0x22000 (AVC_VLD), 0x24000, 0x29000, 0x2e000 (larb4).

  T02CHECK mmio_bad=0 mmio_reads=16 mmio_writes=16 violations=0
  T02CHECK PASS

So DEC07s fake change and my model change agree; no offset aliasing, no fake rule violations. Two notes for the fake patch: (1) enlarging N2VC_FAKE_WIN_WORDS to 0xc000 makes every window 0x30000/4 words, ~2.5 MB for the struct, which is fine on the heap but would be too big for a stack instance; (2) the fake needs the per-page power rule only if you want it (window 12 -> RWVC_BLK_VDEC_CORE powers everything, while page 0x0d000/0x2e000 really belong to VDE and 0x2xxxx to VDE2 -- DEC07s per-page block map is the accurate one, my quick staging used the flat core block).

Not part of my package (no file changed); reproducible if wanted, but the command is a throwaway under /tmp/n2hw-DEC04/t02_check.
